rationale: EASA NPA 2025-07(B) Table 1 explicitly assigns defined levels of end-user authority and responsibility to Levels 1A through 3A, while Level 3B is marked 'Reserved' with 'n/a' for both fields. The claim accurately reflects this text and its proposed status, correctly noting that Level 3B is not currently defined as an approved no-human-involvement category within this document.
limitations: Requires verification against final EASA decisions or successor AMC/GM material, as the current evidence is only a proposed amendment (NPA).
Does not establish a universal taxonomy or map to SAE road-automation levels.
